title: Trigor's chain is marked by its summon, so a played Trigor set by Dino-size still summons
sources: Issue #2206, part 13 of the tracker #2193 (REVIEW B-1)
notes: R2206000: TG #25 Trigor's Death marks the Trigor it summons in that Trigor's memory, and a Trigor so marked this turn summons nothing when it dies this turn (R2197004). The terminator read a stat override before, so a played Trigor that TG #34 Dino-size or a Set stats touched summoned nothing when it died that turn. A fresh summon may seed the card's memory (§6.3). The other two cards claimed are those classify's unforced games meet beside a Trigor chain whose games diverge: their own play is unchanged.

player.title: Trigor
fixes: A Trigor you played whose stats were set this turn, by Dino-size for instance, now summons its successor when it dies, as its text says.
